subject: general
question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed from left to right in the blanks of the given series will complete the letter series.

A _ _ O U A E I _ _ A _ I _ U A E _ O _

options.text: E I U O O E I U
E I O U O E U I
E I U O E O I U
E I O U E O I U

solution:
The logic followed here is:

Given Sequence: A _ _ O U A E I _ _ A _ I _ U A E _ O _

Now, putting the letters in the blank spaces given in the option one by one:

Option 1) E I U O O E I U → A __E__ __I__ O U / A E I __U__ __O__ / A __O__ I __E__ U / A E __I__<span style="color: rgb(33, 37, 41);&quo
